ruleDefinitions.name: Rundll32 UNC Path Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects rundll32 execution where the DLL is located on a remote location (share)

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "RUNDLL32\.EXE" OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rundll32.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\\\\\\\.*"))
